title: We’re Building a Game Engine for Your AI (and Non-AI) Videos
author: cicla
selftext:
My friend and I have been working on this engine for the last six months and we feel like we are ready to start showing it around.   
The name is StoryBranch:  
https://storybranch.app/  
It’s an app that lets you create games from the videos and photos straight from your phone’s library.  
There’s no need to download anything or even register.  
You can make quizzes, adventure games, point-and-click games, and even interactive presentations.  
My friend and I have been working on it for about six months. It’s still a work in progress.  
If you want to see what’s possible, check out this point-and-click adventure game we’re currently putting together (also a work in progress):  
https://jayclay-storybranch-example.netlify.app/  
We’re using AI to generate the video clips, scripts, and voices. Once the assets are ready, our engine makes it incredibly easy to turn them into a game.

Would appreciate any feedback you might have!
